$comment: Embedded API runtime compatibility ledger. Edit here, then run pnpm sync:docs; TestCompatLedger validates it.
denominator: The WinterTC Minimum Common Web Platform API globals, plus the Node globals route handlers commonly reach for (Buffer, process, setImmediate, require, node: modules as one class).

events.title: Events and abort
events.description: DOMException, Event, EventTarget, AbortController and AbortSignal.

timers.title: Timers
timers.description: setTimeout and friends, queueMicrotask and performance, driven by the Go job loop.

url.title: URL
url.description: URL (parsed by the Go host) and URLSearchParams.

fetch.title: Fetch, Request and Response
fetch.description: Headers, Request, Response and fetch (performed by the Go host). The API and middleware runners always use this feature.

streams.title: Streams
streams.description: ReadableStream and its default reader, plus the unsupported stream stubs.

formdata.title: Blob, File and FormData
formdata.description: Blob, File and FormData, with multipart parsing in the Go host.

crypto.title: Crypto
crypto.description: crypto.getRandomValues, randomUUID and crypto.subtle (digest and HMAC in the Go host).

console.title: Console
console.description: console methods backed by the Go host.

node.title: Node globals
node.description: The Node globals the embedded runtime provides outside the prelude (process.env, a minimal require) and the ones it lacks.

engine.title: Engine built-ins
engine.description: Globals that come from the QuickJS engine itself, not the prelude.

global.title: Global object
global.description: Global object aliases and properties that no prelude section provides yet.
